finding_key: docs/design/backend.md::data-model + api change not folded into the canonical backend design doc; a new parallel top-level doc was created instead
evidence: Verified against the supplied files: docs/design/backend.md's ER block still lists Document with `createdAt` only (no `updatedAt`), its module table describes DocumentModule as just "Document REST endpoints" with no YorkieEventController/YorkieSignatureGuard, and its API reference has no `POST /internal/yorkie/events`; the diff never touches backend.md and instead adds a new top-level docs/design/documents-last-modified.md. The cited conventions are real — CONTRIBUTING.md says "Update the existing doc when evolving an area instead of creating parallel files," and docs/design/README.md's "Obsolete docs" section says to fold single-PR notes into the canonical doc. Mitigating context: backend.md's schema block was already stale (it omits `type`, `fileId`, `workspaceId` from earlier migrations), and the repo hosts many standalone topic docs, so this is incremental doc drift rather than a new pattern. Docs-only, no runtime or correctness impact, hence nit.
